identity.summary: Approved logo geometry and source masters remain unchanged. Seven edited brands receive patch package versions for messaging; identity remains governed by their existing continuity records.

palette.summary: Existing palette values and WCAG 2.1 AA rules remain unchanged.

typography.summary: Approved local font families, faces, and licenses remain unchanged.

platform_assets.summary: Regenerate and repin to adopt exact approved messaging in generated packages. Approved logo geometry, platform icon layouts and social-image compositions remain unchanged.

web_react.summary: Web and React adapter APIs and interface token behavior remain unchanged.

egui.summary: The egui adapter API and output semantics remain unchanged.

wordpress.summary: Regenerate WordPress starters to adopt exact approved site descriptions and omit the hero description when the canonical site-metadata role is absent or unresolved. WordPress adapter 1.0.0 retains its public API.

documentation.summary: Publish seven brands' exact approved message decisions, corrected portfolio heading and complete card-title layout, and all 68 labeled References entries. Brand Canon 2.1.0 and existing adapter APIs remain unchanged.

recovery.summary: Repinning BrandBuilder 3.1.1 requires exact new package IDs and checksums. The site hosts thirteen verified brands; ten owned archives join the skill and portable distribution, while three client kits remain hosted candidates. Previously published packages remain immutable recovery inputs.
